lines.en: label tsuneyodorm10:
: Tsuneyo, are you in there?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你在里面吗？

lines.en: : Let’s hang out.
lines.zh: : 我们出去逛逛吧。

lines.en: I hear a set of footsteps quietly approach the door and stop right in front of it.
lines.zh: 我听见一阵脚步声轻轻靠近门，然后在门正前方停了下来。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why not? I’m bored and you’re not doing anything.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？我很闲，你也没在忙什么。

lines.en: : I’m doing plenty of things.
lines.zh: : 我忙的事多着呢。

lines.en: : What could you possibly be doing in there?
lines.zh: : 你能在里面忙什么？

lines.en: : Homework.
lines.zh: : 作业。

lines.en: : I don’t give you any homework.
lines.zh: : 我没给你留过作业。

lines.en: : Noodle homework.
lines.zh: : 面条作业。

lines.en: ...What the fuck does that even mean?
lines.zh: ...这到底是什么鬼意思？

lines.en: : Studying different types of wheat.
lines.zh: : 研究不同种类的小麦。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Put your noodles on hold for a few minutes and talk to me.
lines.zh: : 把你的面条先放几分钟，陪我说说话。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Please enter.
lines.zh: : 请进。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo unlocks the door and I make my way into the room, stepping over a few plastic bags piled near the entrance along the way.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把门打开，我走进房间，顺手跨过堆在门口的几个塑料袋。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten1
: Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Hey. What’s up with the pajamas?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你这身睡衣是怎么回事？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean like...They’re cute and everything...but what’s up with that smiley face?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……它挺可爱的什么的……可那个笑脸是怎么回事？

lines.en: : It’s kind of creepy, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 有点瘆人，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten2
: It’s a normal smile. Don't make fun of my clothes just because you hate joy.
lines.zh: : 那就是个普通的笑脸。别因为你讨厌快乐就嘲笑我的衣服。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}hate{/i} joy.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}讨厌{/i}快乐。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten1
: Then why don’t you ever smile?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么从来不笑？

lines.en: : You should try to be like this shirt. But with more energy and less cotton.
lines.zh: : 你该学学这件衬衫。但要更有活力一点，棉布少一点。

lines.en: : You’re the last person I want to hear about energy from. You have like three facial expressions.
lines.zh: : 我最不想听的就是你来谈活力。你总共就三副表情。

lines.en: : Did you come here to fight?
lines.zh: : 你是来吵架的吗？

lines.en: : What? No. I was just going along with your banter.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我只是在接你的话茬。

lines.en: : Besides, I think you look cute. Even if your shirt is a little weird.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你挺可爱的。就算你的衬衫有点怪。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten3
: Weird?
: Well...Not weird. Just different.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是怪。只是特别。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound any better.
lines.zh: : 这话听着也没好到哪去。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten1
: This shirt was a gift from my father and I would greatly appreciate it if you would keep your comments to yourself.
lines.zh: : 这件衬衫是我父亲送的，如果你能闭上嘴，我会非常感激。

lines.en: : I am embarrassed enough to be seen like this in general.
lines.zh: : 光是被别人看到我这副样子，就已经够让我难为情了。

lines.en: : You don’t look very embarrassed to me.
lines.zh: : 我看你一点也不难为情。

lines.en: : That's because I only have three facial expressions. You said it yourself.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我只有三副表情。你自己说的。

lines.en: Yeah, but I feel like one of those is actually the embarrassed one.
lines.zh: 话是这么说，可我觉得其中一副恰恰就是难为情的表情。

lines.en: Tsuneyo seems fine to me. Sure, her posture is a little different than normal, but it’s not like she’s curled up in the corner or anything.
lines.zh: 在我看来 Tsuneyo 挺好的。当然，她的姿势跟平时有点不一样，但她也没缩在角落里什么的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten4
: So is there a real reason for your appearance today? Or is it just to hurt me?
lines.zh: : 那么你今天来是要干什么？还是单纯为了伤害我？

lines.en: : I’m not here to hurt you...
lines.zh: : 我不是来伤害你的……

lines.en: : You have the eyes of a man who is here to hurt a quirky noodle-girl.
lines.zh: : 你有一双专门来伤害古怪面条女孩的男人的眼睛。

lines.en: : I know Kendo. I can kill you.
lines.zh: : 我学过剑道。我能杀了你。

lines.en: : I know you do. It’s one of your two defining interests.
lines.zh: : 我知道你学过。那是你仅有的两个标志性爱好之一。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten5
: Tsuneyo Tojo, Soup Warrior.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo，汤之战士。

lines.en: : What happened to ‘Samurai of Flavor?’
lines.zh: : 「风味武士」这个称号怎么了？

lines.en: : Samurai by day, warrior by night.
lines.zh: : 白天当武士，夜里当战士。

lines.en: : Well, at least you know what you’re into. That’s more than I can say for myself.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少你知道自己感兴趣什么。这点我就比不上。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten6
: Ahh, right. You are the man who loves nothing.
lines.zh: : 啊，对了。你就是那个什么都不爱的男人。

lines.en: : You said that at the restaurant the other day when the girl with the strange eyes asked you to list the things you enjoyed.
lines.zh: : 那天在餐厅，那个眼睛很怪的女孩让你列出喜欢的东西时，你是这么说的。

lines.en: The man who loves nothing, huh?
lines.zh: 什么都不爱的男人，是吗？

lines.en: That’s a pretty badass nickname.
lines.zh: 这外号还挺带感的。

lines.en: Depressing, sure. But still cool.
lines.zh: 确实挺丧的。但还是很酷。

lines.en: I can live with this.
lines.zh: 我能接受。

lines.en: : That's right. I hate everything.
lines.zh: : 没错。我什么都讨厌。

lines.en: : Speaking of Kaori, though, have you run into her at all since then?
lines.zh: : 不过说到 Kaori，从那以后你有没有碰见过她？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten7
: I think she was looking around my backyard the other day.
lines.zh: : 我想前两天她在我家后院到处张望来着。

lines.en: : Is that legal?
lines.zh: : 那合法吗？

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概不合法。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten8
: Is she dangerous? Do I need to call the police?
lines.zh: : 她危险吗？我需要报警吗？

lines.en: : She seems rather frail, so I could probably snap her neck instead if that’s easier.
lines.zh: : 她看起来挺纤弱的，如果更省事的话，我大概可以直接拧断她的脖子。

lines.en: : Okay, well definitely don’t do that. Kaori isn’t evil, she’s just...weird.
lines.zh: : 好吧，千万别那么做。Kaori 不是坏人，她只是……古怪。

lines.en: : She probably just thinks it was strange that you wouldn’t hire her.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是觉得你不肯雇她这件事很奇怪。

lines.en: : The Soup Warrior needs no assistance. Just time and ingredients.
lines.zh: : 汤之战士不需要帮手。只需要时间和食材。

lines.en: : And your father is totally cool with that? He doesn’t think you need any more help?
lines.zh: : 你父亲对此完全没意见？他不觉得你需要更多人手？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten9
: He has not weighed in on the matter. This is a decision I made for myself.
lines.zh: : 他没有对此发表意见。这是我自己做的决定。

lines.en: : My father has had a profound influence on the way I approach life, but he does not decide everything for me.
lines.zh: : 我父亲对我的人生态度影响深远，但他不会替我决定一切。

lines.en: : Weren’t you just saying the other day how you tell him virtually everything you do?
lines.zh: : 你前两天不是还说，你做的事几乎都会告诉他？

lines.en: : Yes. But not because he asks. It’s because I want to.
lines.zh: : 是的。但不是因为他问，而是因为我想说。

lines.en: : Is it wrong to share your feelings with the person you love?
lines.zh: : 和自己爱的人分享心声，有错吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten10
: Wait, don’t answer that.
lines.zh: : 等等，别回答这个问题。

lines.en: : You do not love anyone or anything. I’m sorry if my question offended you.
lines.zh: : 你不爱任何人，也不爱任何东西。如果我的问题冒犯了你，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Wow, you didn’t even give me a chance to respond that time.
lines.zh: : 哇，这次你连让我回答的机会都不给。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I accidentally think you’re a normal person and say more than I should.
lines.zh: : 有时候我会不小心把你当成正常人，然后说了不该说的话。

lines.en: : Why is it that every time you address me, I feel myself becoming less and less human?
lines.zh: : 为什么每次你跟我说话，我都觉得自己越来越不像个人了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten11
: Were you ever human to begin with?
lines.zh: : 你从一开始是人吗？

lines.en: : This is exactly what I'm talking about.
lines.zh: : 我说的就是这个。

lines.en: : But what about you, Tsuneyo? Are {i}you{/i} human?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，Tsuneyo？{i}你{/i}是人吗？

lines.en: : Is anyone human?
lines.zh: : 有人是人吗？

lines.en: : Or are we all simply objects put here for the enjoyment of some higher power?
lines.zh: : 还是说我们都只是被摆在这里、供某种更高存在取乐的物件？

lines.en: : Left to wander the earth in search of the ultimate flavor combination.
lines.zh: : 被丢到世上流浪，寻找终极的风味组合。

lines.en: : That was actually a pretty thought-provoking question until you got to the flavor part.
lines.zh: : 这问题其实还挺引人深思的，直到你扯到风味那部分。

lines.en: : My father’s words. The flavor part was what I added to it.
lines.zh: : 那是我父亲的话。风味那部分是我自己加的。

lines.en: : I think it makes it more interesting. And delicious.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这样更有趣。也更美味。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten12
Tsuneyo moves over to her bed and sits down, bringing one of her hands to her arm and clutching it gently to steady the nerves that I imagine she's buried deep down inside somewhere.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 走到床边坐下，一只手搭在手臂上轻轻握住，好稳住我想象中被她深埋在心底某个角落的紧张。

lines.en: She hasn’t really shown much emotion at all since I’ve met her.
lines.zh: 从我认识她以来，她几乎没表现出什么情绪。

lines.en: And sure, maybe that’s just her personality...But maybe it’s something more than that?
lines.zh: 当然，也许那只是她的性格……但也许不只是性格的问题？

lines.en: She has no problems talking about her father, it seems.
lines.zh: 谈起父亲时，她似乎没什么障碍。

lines.en: Maybe he is the key to her heart?
lines.zh: 也许他就是打开她心扉的钥匙？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten13
: Why did you follow me to my bed?
lines.zh: : 你为什么跟着我到床边来？

lines.en: : Because we were in the middle of a conversation. Was I not supposed to?
lines.zh: : 因为我们话说到一半。我不该跟过来吗？

lines.en: : I’d personally feel more comfortable if you stood by the door.
lines.zh: : 如果你站在门边，我个人会觉得更自在。

lines.en: : But I’m already here.
lines.zh: : 可我已经过来了。

lines.en: : Are any of us {i}really{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 有谁{i}真的{/i}在这里吗？

lines.en: : You’re pretty philosophical today for someone who has already admitted to that not being a strong point.
lines.zh: : 对于一个亲口承认哲学不是强项的人来说，你今天还挺有哲学味的。

lines.en: : And you’re a bitch.
lines.zh: : 而且你是个 bitch。

lines.en: : Did Molly teach you that word as well?
lines.zh: : 这个词也是 Molly 教你的？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten14
: Did I use it correctly?
lines.zh: : 我用对了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t need to do push-ups to break a curse this time, do I?
lines.zh: : 这次我不用做俯卧撑来解咒了吧？

lines.en: : No. Just try not to use that to anyone you don’t inherently dislike. It’s not exactly a great word.
lines.zh: : 不用。只是别对不是本来就讨厌的人用这个词。它算不上什么好词。

lines.en: : Understood, bitch.
lines.zh: : 明白了，bitch。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten15
: Heh...
: Woah, what’s this?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，这是什么？

lines.en: : Proof that I have more facial expressions.
lines.zh: : 证明我不止三副表情。

lines.en: : And also a joke. Feel free to laugh.
lines.zh: : 也是个玩笑。想笑就笑吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think you are a bitch.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你是个 bitch。

lines.en: : That’s such a strange sentence, and yet it fills me with such joy...
lines.zh: : 这句话真奇怪，却让我心里充满了喜悦……

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten14
: Does it? I thought you were immune to joy?
lines.zh: : 是吗？我还以为你对喜悦免疫呢？

lines.en: : I never said that. Those are your words.
lines.zh: : 我从没说过。那是你的用词。

lines.en: : I’m one of the happiest people you’ll ever meet.
lines.zh: : 我是你见过最幸福的人之一。

lines.en: : I wake up every day, go to[school], talk to cute girls and, every once in a while, they’ll even let me into their rooms.
lines.zh: : 我每天醒来，去[school]，跟可爱的女孩说话，偶尔她们还会让我进她们的房间。

lines.en: : What more out of life could I ask for?
lines.zh: : 我还能对生活有什么别的要求？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten16
: That tangent filled me with disgust and I’m not sure why.
lines.zh: : 刚才那通歪理让我觉得恶心，而且我不知道为什么。

lines.en: : Are you what they call a “pervert?”
lines.zh: : 你就是他们说的那种“变态”吗？

lines.en: : Probably, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，是啊。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten17
: And I’m in my pajamas...
lines.zh: : 而且我还穿着睡衣……

lines.en: : I am becoming weaker.
lines.zh: : 我在变弱。

lines.en: : I should never have let my guard down.
lines.zh: : 我就不该放松警惕。

lines.en: : Please, just take my money and leave. I beg you.
lines.zh: : 求你了，拿上我的钱走吧。我求你了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I’m not going to do anything to you.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我不会对你做什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t even know {i}what{/i} you would do to begin with. I just know it’s bad.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道你打算{i}做什么{/i}。我只知道那很糟糕。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten18
: {i}What was the spell she taught me again?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她教我的咒语是什么来着？……{/i}

lines.en: : Umm...Holy Bulwark!
lines.zh: : 嗯……神圣壁垒！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, what in the world are you doing?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你到底在干什么？

lines.en: : Casting...Holy Bulwark?
lines.zh: : 施放……神圣壁垒？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten19
: Why doesn’t it have any effect?
lines.zh: : 为什么一点效果都没有？

lines.en: : Did I get the spell wrong?
lines.zh: : 我念错咒语了吗？

lines.en: : There’s no spell to begin with...
lines.zh: : 本来就不存在什么咒语……

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten20
: Are you immune?!
lines.zh: : 你免疫吗？！

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re joking right now or not.
lines.zh: : 我现在分不清你是在开玩笑还是认真的。

lines.en: : Who would joke at a time like this?! My magic is gone!
lines.zh: : 这种时候谁会开玩笑？！我的魔法没了！

lines.en: : It was technically never there to begin with, but now it’s REALLY not there!
lines.zh: : 严格来说它本来就不存在，但现在是真的一点都不存在了！

lines.en: : You’re spending way too much time with Molly.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Molly 待太久了。

lines.en: : Put your hands down. I’m not going to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 把手放下。我不会伤害你的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten17
: I’ll also give you a little tip to prevent you from misfiring your spells if something like this ever comes up again, which I can guarantee it will.
lines.zh: : 我再给你一个小贴士，免得以后再遇到这种事你又放错咒语——而这种事我保证还会发生。

lines.en: : Pretty much every male you have ever talked to is a pervert in some sense of the word.
lines.zh: : 基本上你跟每个说过话的男性，从某种意义上说都是变态。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten21
: All of them?!
lines.zh: : 全部？！

lines.en: : Yup. Even your father, most likely.
lines.zh: : 对。大概连你父亲也不例外。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten22
: Then the Emerald Guardian was correct when she told me that girls are the ones I want to ally with.
lines.zh: : 那翡翠守护者说得没错，她说我该结盟的是女孩们。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like there are that many men around anymore to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我是说，反正现在周围的男人本来也没剩多少了。

lines.en: : If you wanted to form an army of all women, I’m pretty sure you could take us down in a moment’s notice.
lines.zh: : 如果你想组建一支全女性的军队，我很确定你们一瞬间就能把我们收拾了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten23
: You are absolutely correct.
lines.zh: : 你说得一点没错。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to question why I was so afraid in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我开始怀疑自己当初到底在怕什么。

lines.en: : Men are weak.
lines.zh: : 男人是弱者。

lines.en: : I will eliminate all of them.
lines.zh: : 我要把他们全部消灭。

lines.en: : ...All of them?
: Except my father. I can not afford to live on my own yet.
lines.zh: : 除了我父亲。我现在还负担不起独自生活。

lines.en: : And his days are numbered anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且他的日子也不多了。

lines.en: : That’s...incredibly morbid.
lines.zh: : 这……真是病态得可以。

lines.en: : As are all things, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 万物皆如此，老师。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten24
: Wherever there are perverts...The Samurai of Flavor will be there to cut them down.
lines.zh: : 哪里有变态……风味武士就会去哪里把他们砍倒。

lines.en: : Wherever there is injustice...The Soup Warrior will be there to restore order.
lines.zh: : 哪里有不公……汤之战士就会去哪里恢复秩序。

lines.en: : Okay Tsuneyo, I-
lines.zh: : 好了 Tsuneyo，我——

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten25
: Wherever there are noodles...Tsuneyo Tojo will be there to eat them!
lines.zh: : 哪里有面条……Tsuneyo Tojo 就会去哪里把它们吃掉！

lines.en: : Okay, that one wasn’t inspiring in the slightest.
lines.zh: : 好了，这一句一点都不鼓舞人心。

lines.en: : I am hungry!
lines.zh: : 我饿了！

lines.en: : I...can see that.
lines.zh: : 我……看得出来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten26
: If we are going to be hanging out tonight, would you like to come with me to the convenience store?
lines.zh: : 既然今晚要一起出去逛逛，你要不要陪我去便利店？

lines.en: : Right now? It’s the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 现在？这可是大半夜。

lines.en: : Is that not the ideal time to go?
lines.zh: : 那难道不是最理想的时间吗？

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian recently introduced me to all of these 24-hour stores and I can feel my life changing every day.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者最近给我介绍了这些 24 小时营业的店，我能感觉到自己的生活每天都在改变。

lines.en: : You...didn’t know about convenience stores?
lines.zh: : 你……以前不知道便利店？

lines.en: : I’ve only just been granted permission to leave the house.
lines.zh: : 我才刚被允许出门。

lines.en: : The entire world is new to me.
lines.zh: : 整个世界对我来说都是新的。

lines.en: The entire world?
lines.zh: 整个世界？

lines.en: That can’t be true, can it?
lines.zh: 这不可能吧，对吗？

lines.en: Tsuneyo’s a [teenage]girl. The chances of her being cooped up in the same house for her entire life are slim to none.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 是个[teenage]女孩。她一辈子被关在同一栋房子里的概率微乎其微。

lines.en: And why now of all times?
lines.zh: 而且为什么偏偏是现在？

lines.en: Why would she suddenly be allowed to start “living her life” in the middle of the[school] year?
lines.zh: 为什么她会突然被允许在[school]年中间开始“过自己的生活”？

lines.en: I imagine her father’s condition has something to do with it, but...
lines.zh: 我想这跟她父亲的病情有关，可是……

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : Food. Please.
lines.zh: : 食物。拜托。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Sure. I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。当然。我陪你去。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten14
: This is good news.
lines.zh: : 这是个好消息。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Because you want to spend more time with me?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？因为你想多跟我待一会儿？

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten13
: No. Because now I won’t get lost.
lines.zh: : 不是。因为这样我就不会迷路了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyodormten15
: Heh...
scene black
Tsuneyo makes me leave the room so she can get dressed and I wind up standing in the barren second floor hallway for a minute or two before she finally comes back.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 让我先出去，好让她换衣服，我在空荡荡的二楼走廊站了一两分钟，她才终于出来。

lines.en: The two of us walk to the convenience store, where she proceeds to stock up on roughly ten different brands of instant ramen, before we decide to separate and head back to our respective homes.
lines.zh: 我们两个走到便利店，她一口气囤了大约十个不同品牌的方便面，然后我们决定就此分开，各自回家。

lines.en: It isn’t until ten minutes after we part ways that I realize there is a good chance that she wound up getting lost on the way back.
lines.zh: 直到分开十分钟后，我才意识到她回去的路上很有可能会迷路。

lines.en: Whoops.
lines.zh: 哎呀。
